intuition.title: Why use solution chemistry
intuition.summary: Solution processing is proposed to improve control of dopant speciation, provide scalable preparation and make nanocrystals processable building blocks. The DMSO procedure is presented as enabling gram quantities in open containers without special precursors, air exclusion or precise temperature stabilization; no isolated mass yield or manufacturing study is supplied.
intuition.scope: Source discussion; interpretation and cited context are distinguished in the text.

intuition.title: Why distinguish surface and internal dopants
intuition.summary: Surface-exposed dopants can differ from substitutional ions in coordination, ligation and electronic exchange. The source stresses both controlling incorporation and experimentally establishing dopant distribution rather than assuming homogeneous doping from nominal feed composition alone.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Mechanisms of Nucleation and Growth of Nanoparticles in Solution

general_background.title: Destabilizing a particle dispersion
general_background.summary: An antisolvent can solvate a particle's ligand shell less favourably than the original dispersion medium. Reduced solvation can weaken colloidal stability and allow particles to aggregate and separate from the liquid, depending on the ligands and solvent mixture.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Prospects of Colloidal Nanocrystals for Electronic and Optoelectronic Applications

general_background.title: Solvent and transport
general_background.summary: A solvent carries dissolved species and transports heat through a reaction or dispersion. Solubility, viscosity and molecular interactions affect how precursors and ligand-coated particles move and mix.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
